paragraphs.text: Harness-kernel mesh for DeepSeek Harness: kimi/grok/codex/minimax model routes (L1), distilled subag
DSH runs on one simple idea: **everything is a plugin**. Models, tools, subagents — plug them togeth
So we did exactly that: we turned four coding harnesses — **Kimi Code**, **Grok Build**, **OpenAI Co
dex**, and **MiniMax Mini-Agent** — into DSH plugins, bundled in this one package.
The payoff is simple: switch to a Kimi / Grok / Codex / MiniMax model inside DSH, and it's **no diff
erent** from opening each one's own CLI. Every model stays in the environment it knows best — main a
gent or subagent, it feels like coming home.
